title: grid: a multi-field row save conflict shows both values as raw JSON in the concurrent-update dialog (buildRowConflict does not fill the new per-field list)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oF8GgTHN2jBZoDwz8

Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect with a named producer, found by the contract review of PR #33547 (record 6886524339, should-fix S2) beside #33346 row 118. Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/plugin-grid`). Grade p3, self-graded by the lane seat under the maintainer's 「定级你可以自己决定」: the same raw-JSON face #33346 row 118 fixed on the inline-edit save, on the grid's row path.
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open buildRowConflict` and `is:issue is:open grid conflict raw JSON` find nothing open.
⛔ Serial: `ObjectGrid.tsx` is in ui seat 1's live #33317 surface; dispatch after #33317's PR merges.

## What the user sees

A grid row save that changed several fields and meets a newer version (409 `CONCURRENT_UPDATE`) opens the concurrent-update dialog with both values printed as raw JSON objects.

## Where (on `main` at `e3f0cfd4`)

- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` `buildRowConflict` builds a single conflict whose values are the whole draft object and the current subset.
- PR #33547 (#33346 row 118) gave `@object-ui/plugin-detail`'s `ConcurrentUpdateConflict` an optional `fields` list (field, label, your edit, current value) that the dialog draws as a readable list; `buildRowConflict` does not fill it yet.

## Acceptance

- A multi-field row conflict fills `fields` (labels from the grid's columns/object schema), so the dialog lists each field; a one-field conflict looks as it does today.
- Pin through the rendered grid: two changed fields + a 409 → two labelled rows, no raw JSON. CONTROL: one field.

Blocked-by: #33547
